# Unpacked test fixtures

Generated by `pkt unpack` from the self-authored, GPL-3.0 sample containers in
[`corpus/samples/`](../../corpus/samples/). These are the reference outputs of
the unpack pipeline and are used as golden files by the test suite.

```
lab/       from corpus/samples/sample_lab.pkt     (PACKETTRACER5, 7 devices, 5 links)
activity/  from corpus/samples/sample_activity.pka (PACKETTRACER5_ACTIVITY, scored)
```

Each directory holds:

| File | Contents |
| --- | --- |
| `*.xml` | The complete inner document, byte-exact |
| `*.container.json` | Container metadata: format, cipher, key/IV bytes, root tag |
| `configs/<device>.cfg` | Device IOS running configuration, as **raw bytes** |
| `topology.dot` | Graphviz rendering |
| `topology.json` | Device/link inventory |

## Regenerating

```console
$ pkt unpack corpus/samples/sample_lab.pkt     -o tests/fixtures/unpacked/lab
$ pkt unpack corpus/samples/sample_activity.pka -o tests/fixtures/unpacked/activity
```

## Why the configs are bytes

IOS running configuration carries raw control characters — the Cisco
`banner motd ^C…^C` delimiters are stored as literal `0x03`. These files are
written as binary so that byte is preserved; do not convert them to text or
normalise line endings.
